title: Planned maintenance – NBN Footscray POI (3FSR)
current_summary: We have scheduled maintenance at the NBN Footscray POI (3FSR) on Tuesday 20 October 2026 between 12:00am and 3:00am AEDT. NBN services served by this POI may experience an interruption of up to 3 hours during the window while we relocate the network interconnect. We’ll work to keep any downtime as short as possible.

cause.reason: NBN interconnect (NNI) rehoming at the Footscray POI

updates.content: Scheduled maintenance: We will be relocating the NBN interconnect at the Footscray POI (3FSR). Services served by this POI may be disrupted for up to 3 hours during the window: Tuesday 20 October 2026, 12:00am–3:00am AEDT.
